supplementalCommits.subject: x86/mm: guard decrypted BSS gap freeing by AMD encryption support
supplementalCommits.rationale: The first prescribed x86 build exposed undefined references to __start_bss_decrypted and __start_bss_decrypted_gap. Upstream now emits BSS_DECRYPTED only under CONFIG_AMD_MEM_ENCRYPT, whereas the old OOT gap-freeing patch referenced its symbols unconditionally. Guard both gap-address declarations and the free operation with the same feature condition. Keep the existing standard kernel configuration unchanged; do not enable AMD_MEM_ENCRYPT merely to compile.
